named_after.pick: Which place is the word {label} named after?
named_after.match: Match each word to the place it is named after.

rows.label: copper
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Cu and atomic number 29
rows.hook: is a reddish-orange metal widely used in electrical wiring and old pennies

rows.label: hamburger
rows.description: American sandwich of ground beef patty
rows.hook: is a bun-wrapped ground beef patty, a staple of American cookouts and fast food

rows.label: Rottweiler
rows.hook: is a big, powerful, black-and-tan dog once used to drive cattle and pull butchers' carts

rows.label: bolognese sauce
rows.hook: is a slow-cooked meat ragu with onion, celery and carrot, often served over pasta

rows.label: Worcestershire sauce
rows.hook: is a tangy fermented condiment, famously made by Lea & Perrins, splashed on steak and Bloody Marys

rows.label: Pomeranian
rows.hook: is a tiny, fluffy toy dog beloved by Queen Victoria

rows.label: Siamese
rows.description: breed of Oriental cat originated in Thailand
rows.hook: is a blue-eyed, dark-pointed cat breed with a loud voice, and the villains of a Disney dog movie

rows.label: Persian cat
rows.hook: is a long-haired, flat-faced cat breed, often a pampered show favorite

rows.label: Siberian Husky
rows.hook: is a thick-coated, blue-eyed sled-pulling dog, famous for the serum run to Nome

rows.label: Abyssinian
rows.hook: is a slender cat breed with a ticked, wildcat-like coat and big ears

rows.label: jalapeño
rows.hook: is a green chili pepper of medium heat, often stuffed with cheese and fried as poppers

rows.label: Port Wine
rows.hook: is a sweet, fortified red from the Douro Valley, traditionally served after dinner

rows.label: Pekingese
rows.hook: is a small, flat-faced toy dog once bred as a companion for Chinese emperors

rows.label: bayonet
rows.description: bladed weapon designed for attachment to a firearm
rows.hook: is a blade fixed to the end of a rifle, turning it into a spear for close combat

rows.label: sherry
rows.description: fortified wine made from white grapes
rows.hook: is a fortified wine from Andalusia, ranging from bone-dry fino to sweet cream styles

rows.label: denim
rows.description: sturdy cotton or cotton-blend twill textile
rows.hook: is the rugged indigo twill cotton cloth used for blue work trousers

rows.label: cashmere
rows.description: fibre obtained from Cashmere goats and other types of goat
rows.hook: is a luxuriously soft wool combed from the undercoat of certain goats, used in pricey sweaters

rows.label: jeans
rows.description: trousers often made from denim or dungaree cloth
rows.hook: are the blue trousers made famous by Levi Strauss and copper rivets

rows.label: bungalow
rows.description: house that is either single-storey or has a second storey built into a sloping roof, popular in North America
rows.hook: is a cozy single-storey house with a wide veranda, a style adapted from colonial India

rows.label: Peking duck
rows.hook: is a roast bird with crackling-thin skin, carved at the table and wrapped in pancakes

rows.label: balkanization
rows.description: geopolitical term for the fragmentation of a region into smaller states

rows.label: tangerine
rows.hook: is a small, sweet, easy-peeling orange citrus fruit related to the mandarin

rows.label: pilsner
rows.hook: is a crisp, golden lager that began in Bohemia and became the world's most copied beer style

rows.label: muslin
rows.hook: is a light, plain-weave cotton cloth, used for cheesecloth-style straining and costume mockups

rows.label: dollar
rows.hook: is the name of the money used in America, Canada and Australia
